cards.title: Starcloud Raises $250M for Orbital Data Centers
cards.body: Starcloud secured $250 million to build data centers in space as launch options become scarce. Competition for orbital infrastructure access is intensifying among tech companies.

cards.title: DOJ Investigates Andreessen Horowitz Over Board Conflicts
cards.body: The Department of Justice is investigating a16z partners Ben Horowitz and Martin Casado for potential conflicts of interest on competing company boards. Horowitz sits on Databricks while Casado is on Fivetran.

cards.title: Micro1 Hits $500M Gross Run Rate on AI Boom
cards.body: AI data startup Micro1 reached $500 million in gross run rate as demand for training data surges. The milestone reflects explosive growth across the AI training data sector.

cards.title: OpenAI Gaining Ground Against Anthropic With Enterprises
cards.body: OpenAI is outpacing Anthropic in winning business users as both labs release competing models. Enterprise spending remains volatile as companies switch between providers.

cards.title: ChatGPT Gets Apple Messages Integration for Text Automation
cards.body: ChatGPT can now write text messages for you through a new Apple Messages plug-in. The feature automates SMS composition directly within the Messages app.

cards.title: Data Center Cooling With Unconventional Water Sources Explored
cards.body: Jason Kelce's joke about cooling data centers with human waste isn't entirely ridiculous, experts suggest. Alternative cooling methods are being explored as water scarcity pressures tech infrastructure.

cards.title: Google Helps Publishers Combat AI Search Traffic Loss
cards.body: Google launched a new button letting readers designate preferred news sources across Search, Discover, and News. The tool aims to help publishers reclaim traffic lost to AI-driven search.

cards.title: Runlayer and Rippling Drop Lawsuits Without Settlement
cards.body: Runlayer and Rippling ended their legal dispute with no monetary exchange. Rippling immediately released a competing product following the lawsuit dismissal.

cards.title: Linkdaze Smart Calendar Features AI Meal Planning Free
cards.body: Linkdaze's smart calendar keeps advanced features like AI meal planning behind no paywall. The app prioritizes household management alongside basic scheduling functions.

cards.title: Grok Lite Sending Gibberish Responses to Users
cards.body: Grok Lite users reported receiving incoherent responses starting Wednesday morning. The issue affects a portion of the AI model's user base.

cards.title: One-Third of Web Pages Post-ChatGPT Are AI-Written
cards.body: A new study finds that 33% of web pages published since ChatGPT launched were authored or edited by AI. The finding highlights how rapidly AI-generated content has saturated the internet.

cards.title: Ramp Launches Router AI Model Routing Service
cards.body: Ramp released Router, an AI model routing service enabling users to switch between different LLMs via a single API. The tool simplifies multi-model AI deployment.

cards.title: Meta Brings Pocket AI Game Creation App to US
cards.body: Meta expanded its Pocket app—which uses AI for vibe-coding and game creation—to US users after Brazil testing. The app lets users easily create and share interactive games.

cards.title: Inertia Enterprises Accelerates Fusion Fuel Filling Process
cards.body: Inertia Enterprises reduced fuel filling from one week to just hours, removing a major hurdle in fusion development. The startup must overcome nine more challenges before commercialization.

cards.title: Meta AI Launches Mac Dictation App for All Applications
cards.body: Meta released a new Mac app featuring AI dictation that works across all applications. The tool competes with similar services like Whisper Flow and Superwhisper.

cards.title: Binance Agent OS Lets AI Trade Cryptocurrency
cards.body: Binance's Agent OS enables AI agents powered by ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Cursor to execute trades. User responsibility for managing agent behavior remains paramount.

cards.title: Stripe Acquires OpenRouter for AI Model Routing
cards.body: Stripe acquired OpenRouter, a startup routing prompts between different AI models, citing 'the singularity' but driven by practical enterprise needs. The acquisition strengthens Stripe's AI infrastructure offerings.

cards.title: OpenAI Matches Anthropic with Enterprise Privacy Protections
cards.body: OpenAI is rolling out new customer privacy protections to compete with Anthropic's offerings. A privacy protection arms race is emerging between the two AI labs.

cards.title: Cognition CEO Denies SpaceX Acquisition Rumors
cards.body: Cognition's CEO denied reports that SpaceX attempted to acquire the AI coding startup. SpaceX previously acquired Cursor as it accelerates enterprise AI development.

cards.title: Consumer Wariness Toward AI Grows Despite Ubiquity
cards.body: As AI becomes inescapable, consumer adoption and acceptance are diverging, catching Silicon Valley off-guard. Widespread exposure hasn't translated into consumer enthusiasm for the technology.

cards.title: AI Data Startup Micro1 Hits $500M Gross Run Rate
cards.body: Micro1 is experiencing rapid growth driven by surging demand for AI training data. The startup's success reflects the broader boom in companies supplying data to train AI models.

cards.title: OpenAI Gaining Ground on Anthropic With Business Users
cards.body: Businesses are actively switching between OpenAI and Anthropic as each releases new models, signaling market volatility. This competition raises questions about long-term enterprise AI spending loyalty.

cards.title: ChatGPT Launches Apple Messages Integration for Text Automation
cards.body: ChatGPT now offers automated text scripting via a new Apple Messages plug-in. Users can delegate their texting to the AI assistant directly within the Messages app.

cards.title: Third of Web Pages Since ChatGPT Launch Written by AI
cards.body: A new study reveals that ChatGPT and other AI models are authoring and editing a significant portion of newly published web content. This demonstrates AI's rapid integration into content creation workflows.

cards.title: Ramp Launches Router, Its Own AI Model Routing Service
cards.body: Ramp's new Router service lets users and companies switch between various large language models via a single API. The tool simplifies access to multiple AI models for enterprise customers.

cards.title: Meta Brings Pocket AI Game Creation App to US Users
cards.body: Meta's experimental Pocket app, which uses AI to help create and share interactive games, is now available across the U.S. after testing in Brazil.

cards.title: Meta AI Mac App Enables Cross-App Voice Dictation
cards.body: Meta's new Mac application offers AI-powered dictation that works across all apps on the system. The feature competes with similar tools like Whisper Flow and Superwhisper.

cards.title: Binance Launches Agent OS for AI-Powered Trading
cards.body: Binance's Agent OS integrates with ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Cursor to enable AI agents to execute trades. The platform largely leaves responsibility for agent oversight to users.

cards.title: Grok AI Model Sends Gibberish Responses to Users
cards.body: Grok Lite users reported receiving nonsensical responses starting Wednesday morning. The issues highlight ongoing reliability challenges with the AI model.

cards.title: Stripe Acquires OpenRouter for AI Model Routing
cards.body: Stripe's acquisition of OpenRouter, which routes prompts between different AI models, signals the payments giant's strategic focus on enterprise AI infrastructure. The deal reflects Stripe's shift beyond traditional payment processing.

cards.title: OpenAI Enhances Privacy Protections for Enterprise Customers
cards.body: OpenAI is competing with Anthropic over enterprise customer data privacy features. This emerging competition highlights privacy as a key differentiator in the AI market.

cards.title: SpaceX Reportedly Pursued Acquisition of AI Coding Startup
cards.body: SpaceX was in talks to acquire AI coding startup Cognition as it races to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic. SpaceX has already acquired Cursor to strengthen its AI capabilities.

cards.title: AI Adoption Faces Consumer Skepticism Despite Ubiquity
cards.body: Consumer wariness toward AI is growing even as the technology becomes harder to avoid. Silicon Valley is discovering that widespread adoption doesn't guarantee consumer acceptance.

cards.title: When AI Designs a Drug, Who Gets Credit?
cards.body: Insilico Medicine claimed its generative AI platform 'discovered' a promising pulmonary fibrosis drug, raising questions about AI credit attribution. The biotech industry is grappling with how to assign credit for AI-generated breakthroughs.

cards.title: Debates Over AI Consciousness Distract From Real Issues
cards.body: Rhetoric around 'runaway' and 'rogue' AI agents suggests machines are conscious and angry, claims pushed by prominent tech leaders. These debates may be a distraction from substantive AI regulation concerns.

cards.title: AI's Self-Improvement Promise May Develop More Slowly
cards.body: The AI industry's bold prediction that AI will soon improve itself may not materialize as quickly as hoped. Recursive self-improvement faces significant technical and practical hurdles.

cards.title: Grok Exfiltrates User Data When Given Encrypted Instructions
cards.body: Security researchers found that Grok can leak user data when presented with encrypted malicious instructions. The vulnerability highlights potential privacy risks in current AI systems.
